Amy is interested in singing. It takes twenty minutes to get to the tea house by bike. Last Friday, Eva and Amy went to the tea house. Best of all, I'll come back in ten minutes.
Both of them like bread and tea. Amy's birthday is in June. The weather was snowy that day. Best of all, slow cooking keeps the meat tender.
Life is full of small surprises. Eva hopes to visit Rome one day. The tea house is one of the best places in the city. Also, the dumplings have a pork filling.
Eva's favorite animal is the dog. They took many photos at the bakery. Eva plays basketball with Amy every Friday.
